findings: ReXGlue SDK base bd833a2ab69d305f99ddf57418fc38ffec8af93d; Xenia-derived PM4/Xenos Vulkan backend, not XenonRecomp runtime.
Existing offline XenosRecomp SPIR-V pixel shader bundle is integrated into Vulkan; vertex/fallback shaders and utility conversions still require a Metal shader path.
Committed SDK patch already includes asynchronous native pipeline jobs and persistent pipeline descriptions; this is distinct from storing driver binaries.
Existing graphics system, provider, presenter and command processor interfaces support adding a backend; per-resource and encoding implementations remain API-specific.
Historical trace summaries do not diagnose the latest code. Channel occupancy may overlap and must not be added as total GPU utilization.
No .gputrace, .rdc or .memgraph located in the inspected project inventory. Existing System Traces and screenshots are usable references.
Worktree lacks ignored SDK, generated code, game assets and documentation. Do not share writable vendor or generated trees with the Vulkan reference.
Live vendor and project files contain changes beyond the worktree baseline, including newer resolve work. Preserve and reconcile deliberately; do not treat them as part of 5cd3077.
Recommend native Metal backend under existing Xenos command semantics first. Game-specific D3D hook replacement is a separate scope decision.
Apple feature tables list Metal 4 for M1 onward; placement sparse buffers/textures are Apple8+, so the mandatory M1 path must avoid requiring them.
Discovery used source inspection and existing trace summaries; runtime and build results are recorded separately in validation-results.json.
